The listings are divided into three major technologies frequently analyzed at NETL: pulverized coal (PC), integrated gasification combined cycle (IGCC), and natural gas combined cycle (NGCC). For instance, if scaling a plant that fires Illinois No. 6, both the scaling exponents and the reference cost should be for a plant that fires Illinois No. 6.
